page.overview:
Who is Rebecca?

Rebecca is the daughter of Scarlett and Kyros, the niece of Viola and the granddaughter of Riku Doldo III. She is the former crown princess of Dressrosa, who forfeited her title to live with her father and currently serves as a to her aunt, Viola.

While living under Donquixote Doflamingo's regime, she was imprisoned and forced to fight as a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum. She joined a tournament to compete for the Mera Mera no Mi, winning the D Block and battling in the finals before Sabo claimed the Devil Fruit.

She is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Dressrosa Arc.

Rebecca is a fair-skinned and tall girl, but slightly shorter than Luffy. She has long, light pink hair, which she wears in a braid. She holds a strong resemblance to her mother.
